title: RootTypeNonObjectBounds
$comment: Issue #270's third shape in the three families the numeric one shares its rendering with. A bound written beside `properties` and no `type` binds only on the kind it is about, and every one of them judged a JSON null instead -- the decode into a Go string or slice takes a null as a no-op with no error, so the null was measured as "" and as an empty array.
